parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-06 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.8 | 18.27 | 18.27
2 | 213.6 | 1.05 | 19.32
3 | 1311.8 | 4.54 | 23.86
4 | 278.0 | 3.10 | 26.96
5 | 1124.7 | 1.46 | 28.42
6 | 291.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-06
Curve type: HK-type
Aquifer depth: >28.4 m (with secondary saturated zones at 18.3–19.3 m and 23.9–27.0 m)
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 45–50 m to tap the deep fractured aquifer starting below 28.4 m. Install casing through the upper alternating weathered and resistive strata down to at least 28.5 m to stabilize the borehole.
